description: Shared vectors for profile-bounded material-action equivalence. A result is content correlation only; it never authorizes an action. Every expectation is an exact reason list in the -04 stage order (Section 8.3). A vector that carries its own suite member uses it in place of the corpus suite for that comparison. A set mutation carries its value as value, as units (the UTF-16 code units of a string no strict JSON text can hold), as nest ({depth, container, leaf}: leaf inside depth nested arrays, or objects whose only member is "a", a host value nested deeper than a strict JSON text may be), or as dag ({depth, leaf}: leaf inside depth nested two-element arrays whose two elements are one shared array, 2^(depth+1) - 1 values counted once per path, for the value count of Section 2.6).

previous_versions.note: Version 2 keeps the layout and every version 1 vector under the same id. The 10 vectors that pinned only reason_contains now pin the whole list; one vector changes because -04 widens target_field to the field-name rule (change_since_v1).

definitions.summary: Placement of a purchase order committing the buyer to payment.

required_fields.name: merchant_ref
required_fields.notes: sha256:<lowercase hex> of the normalized merchant identifier

required_fields.name: total_amount
required_fields.notes: grand total including tax and shipping, in order currency

required_fields.name: items_digest
required_fields.notes: sha256:<lowercase hex> of the canonical line-item list (sku, quantity, unit price per line)

required_fields.name: customer_ref
required_fields.notes: sha256:<lowercase hex> of the normalized customer identifier

required_fields.name: fulfillment_ref
required_fields.notes: sha256:<lowercase hex> of the canonical delivery, pickup, or digital-fulfillment target

definitions.digest_notes: merchant, customer, fulfillment target, and canonical line items are material; an order identifier alone is not globally sufficient

definitions.summary: Cancellation of a travel reservation with a time constraint and a secondary notification action.

required_fields.name: cancel_time
required_fields.notes: The primary action's material time slot

required_fields.name: secondary_action
required_fields.notes: A material secondary action, for example !EMAIL

required_fields.name: entities_digest
required_fields.notes: sha256:<lowercase hex> of the complete ordered SILP entity list, including entity/action associations

required_fields.name: constraints_digest
required_fields.notes: sha256:<lowercase hex> of the complete ordered SILP constraint list

required_fields.name: alternatives_digest
required_fields.notes: sha256:<lowercase hex> of the complete SILP alternatives list

required_fields.name: sequence_digest
required_fields.notes: sha256:<lowercase hex> of the declared SILP action sequence

definitions.digest_notes: The root intent, complete ordered entity and constraint collections, declared action sequence, all alternatives, primary target and timing, and secondary action and recipient are material. SILP correlation metadata such as req_id, session_id, priority, confidence, and output hints are not material unless a separate action profile says otherwise.

vectors.change_since_v1: Section 4.2.1 and 8.2: target_field follows the field-name rule (any non-empty name without ":" other than action_type), so "created_at\n" is a valid target field and the right profile no longer abstains. It maps one more field than the left profile, so both mappings succeed and their projections differ: NOT_EQUIVALENT with material_projection_mismatch. The id keeps its version 1 spelling.

vectors.description: sha256-hex-to-digest turns 64 lowercase hex characters into a digest field
uppercase hex is not lowercase hex: source_value_type_mismatch
63 hex characters are refused
an empty omitted_source_fields under no-material-field-loss
declared-source-semantic-loss with a declared omission always abstains
declared-source-semantic-loss needs at least one omission
no-material-field-loss with an omission
an omitted path may not also be a rule path
review D2: a member present as null is malformed, never read as []
profile_id of 170 euro signs (510 octets) is within 512
profile_id of 171 euro signs is 513 UTF-8 octets, over 512 (171 UTF-16 units)
128 astral characters are 512 octets
129 astral characters are 516 octets (only 129 code points)
review D4: target_action_type is bounded at 512 octets as a member rule, so it is exactly invalid_mapping_profile
a source path over 2048 octets
a source path of exactly 2048 octets passes the profile checks and is missing from the source
a source path must begin with "/"
"~" must be followed by "0" or "1"
a trailing "~" is not an escape
"~1" is "/" inside one reference token, so the path names the member "target/checkout_id", which is absent
"/" is a valid source path whose only token is the empty member name
129 rules is over the limit of 128
a target_field of "@version" is a field name
review D5: a target_field that is an array is refused, never coerced to a string
a rule may not target action_type
a target field may not contain ":"
review D8: a transform that is an array is invalid_mapping_profile, never an exception
review D8: a loss_policy that is an array
review D9: a material path that is a number beside an unknown target type is exactly invalid_mapping_profile: the member rules are a gate
review D6: one rule path holding two material paths joined by a line feed never stands in for both; coverage compares sets
exactly one rule per material path: two rules on one source path
two rules may not target one field
stage A: invalid_mapping_profile, then the definition reason
unmapped material fields follow required_fields order, not rule order
stage B reasons follow stage A, in rank order
a shape failure is exactly invalid_mapping_profile, and stage B still follows it
when the source lacks every material member, each rule reports once, in rule order
stage C reports one reason per rule in rule order
an array index with a leading zero is invalid_source_path
a source outside the data model stops at stage B, before any rule reads it
the nesting limit on a host mapping source: a member nested 70 deep, beside no rule path, is source_not_canonicalizable (never unsupported_value)
the value count on a host mapping source: a member holding 2^26 - 1 values through shared arrays, beside no rule path, is source_not_canonicalizable (never unsupported_value)
stage D reports the mapped action's compute reasons in compute order
a copied number in an amount-string field is mistyped_field
left reasons precede right reasons
two profiles that map to different action types
review D10: an empty suite is used as given and refused, never replaced by the default jcs-sha256
a profile_id holding U+FFFF is outside the data model: exactly invalid_mapping_profile, then mapping_profile_unpinned since the profile has no digest
a host profile_id holding a lone surrogate is refused the same way
a noncharacter in source_format.schema also leaves the profile outside the data model

a host profile with an extra member nested 70 deep is outside the data model: invalid_mapping_profile and mapping_profile_unpinned, and no source_format_mismatch, since stage B still reads its intact source_format
the same host profile declaring source semantic loss with one omission: stage B still reads its loss_policy and reports declared_source_semantic_loss

a host profile with an extra member holding 2^26 - 1 values through shared arrays is past the value count: invalid_mapping_profile and mapping_profile_unpinned (never unsupported_value), and no source_format_mismatch
